title: 第14章 牌面第15章 结果
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
‘序列九，或者刚晋升序列八不久？灵性感觉还不算太稳固……’莫甘娜迅速做出了判断，目光在莫雷蒂身上快速扫过。
他看起来年轻，衣着普通，气质温和，努力维持着镇定，但那双褐色的眼眸深处，似乎隐藏着一丝极力压抑的紧张？
是因为发现我能感觉到他的灵视了吗？
那么，问题来了，一个低序列的、看似缺乏常识的野生非凡者，为什么会出现在廷根市一家面向普通人的占卜俱乐部里？
是单纯的赚取钱财？还是另有图谋？
莫甘娜不动声色地走到克莱恩对面的高背椅上坐下，双手优雅地交叠放在膝上。
她决定先静观其变。
如果对方没有进一步的、带有恶意的举动，莫甘娜也不想节外生枝。
毕竟，她自己也在为晋升的事情烦恼，不想卷入不必要的麻烦。
房间内的气氛看似平和，实则暗流涌动。
两人陷入了一种微妙的寂静。
莫甘娜迅速收束内心的波澜，脸上没有流露出丝毫异样。
莫甘娜没有举报莫雷蒂这位野生非凡者的意思，自己也算是半个野生非凡者，平时遇到野生同行，只要对方安分守己，没有违法乱纪，都是睁一只眼闭一只眼。
‘就当是什么都不知道就好了。’莫甘娜在心底默念，优雅地抚平裙摆，在克莱恩对面的高背椅上落座，‘还有，她就一个没有任何战斗力的戏法大师，表面说着是序列8，实际上一些序列9都能吊打自己，真没有这个实力！’
就在她坐下的瞬间，那道若有似无的窥视感悄然消失。
莫甘娜眉梢微动，立刻明白了是对方关闭了灵视。
看来莫雷蒂先生也不想闹出什么事情。
不过，这位莫雷蒂先生倒是机灵，即便不是“占卜家”途径的非凡者，也能将灵视运用得如此娴熟，要不是遇到自己，他这个占卜家还能做上一段时间。
只可惜，等自己走时候，这位先生就要换地方了吧。
“下午好，女士，请问怎么称呼你呢？”作为占卜者，克莱恩率先询问道。

“下午好，莫雷蒂先生。”莫甘娜声音平稳，仿佛刚才那片刻的灵**锋从未发生，“我姓维斯珀。”
克莱恩保持着专业而温和的微笑，“很高兴能为您服务，维斯珀小姐，不知您今天想进行哪方面的占卜？要使用什么方式呢？”
克莱恩的动作流畅自然，但莫甘娜敏锐地捕捉到他的紧张。
果然，他也察觉到了自己的非凡者身份。
此刻两人心照不宣地维持着这场伪装。
“我想占卜一件事情我是否应该做，您推荐哪种方式呢？”莫甘娜故意反问，想看看这位野生同行会如何应对。
克莱恩的右手无意识地摩挲着左袖，‘她应该不会是临时想的吧？想占卜一下能不能抓住我？’心里千回百转，面上克莱恩还是谨慎的回答，“我涉猎过不少占卜方式，塔罗、灵摆、梦境解析、星盘占卜......都略知一二。”
什么都略知一二？
莫甘娜的瞳孔微微放大，这样的能力，序列9，对方是“占卜家”途径的非凡者！
莫甘娜忽的想起不久前邓恩说过的，有关安提哥努斯家族笔记的案件。
content_en:
‘Sequence nine, or just promoted to sequence eight? The spiritual feeling is not too stable yet...' Morgana made a quick judgment and her eyes quickly swept over Moretti.
He looks young, dressed in ordinary clothes, and has a gentle temperament. He is trying to maintain his composure, but deep in his brown eyes, there seems to be a trace of suppressed tension hidden?
Is it because I discovered that I can feel his spiritual vision?
So, the question is, why does a low-sequence wild Extraordinary who seems to lack common sense appear in a divination club for ordinary people in Tingen City?
Is it simply to make money? Or is there another plan?
Morgana calmly walked to the high-backed chair opposite Klein and sat down, her hands elegantly folded on her lap.
She decided to wait and see.
If the other party doesn't take any further malicious actions, Morgana doesn't want to cause trouble.
After all, she herself was worried about promotion and didn't want to get involved in unnecessary trouble.
The atmosphere in the room seemed peaceful, but in fact there was an undercurrent.
The two fell into a delicate silence.
Morgana quickly calmed down her inner turmoil without showing any signs of strangeness on her face.
Morgana had no intention of reporting Moretti, a wild Beyonder. She was considered half a wild Beyonder. When she met her wild counterparts, as long as the other party behaved themselves and did not break the law or discipline, she would turn a blind eye.
‘Just pretend you don’t know anything. ’ Morgana muttered silently in her heart, smoothed her skirt gracefully, and sat down on the high-backed chair opposite Klein, ‘Also, she is just a magic master without any fighting ability. She is said to be a Sequence 8 on the surface, but in fact some Sequence 9s can beat her. She really doesn’t have this strength! ’
The moment she sat down, the vague sense of peeping quietly disappeared.
Morgana's eyebrows moved slightly, and she immediately understood that the other party had turned off her spiritual vision.
It seems that Mr. Moretti doesn't want to cause any trouble.
However, this Mr. Moretti is quite clever. Even if he is not an extraordinary person in the "divineer" path, he can still use his spiritual vision so skillfully. If he hadn't met him, he could still be a diviner for a while.
It's a pity that when I leave, this gentleman will have to change places.
"Good afternoon, madam, what should I call you?" As a diviner, Klein asked first.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Moretti." Morgana's voice was steady, as if the spiritual breakthrough just now had never happened, "My surname is Vesper."
Klein maintained a professional and gentle smile, "It's a pleasure to serve you, Miss Vesper. I wonder what kind of divination you want to perform today? What method do you want to use?"
Crane's movements were smooth and natural, but Morgana keenly captured his nervousness.
Sure enough, he also realized his identity as an extraordinary person.
At this moment, the two of them maintained this disguise tacitly.
"I want to divine whether I should do something. Which method do you recommend?" Morgana asked deliberately, wanting to see how this wild colleague would respond.
Klein's right hand unconsciously rubbed his left sleeve, 'She couldn't have thought of it on the spur of the moment, right? Do you want to divine whether you can catch me? ’ Although his mind was spinning over and over again, Klein still answered cautiously, “I have dabbled in many divination methods, including tarot, pendulum, dream analysis, and astrolabe divination… I know a thing or two about them all.”
Know a little bit about everything?
Morgana's pupils dilated slightly. With such an ability, Sequence 9, the opponent is an Extraordinary of the "Soothsayer" path!
Morgana suddenly remembered what Dunn had said not long ago about the case about the Antigonus family notes.
